items.title: Manuel Mello Interview, 1959-08-03
items.q: William Schenk was there. He was the proprietor of the saloon and the Green Roof, too.

ctx.x: Which was your very first job playing music professionally? Professionally?

We played for the Green Roof Social Club, Marais and Bethania. William Schenk was there. He was the proprietor of the saloon and the Green Roof, too. That was the first job I ever played. With a magnificent sum of $2, four hours. That wasn't bad for those days. No, it was pretty good. Next.
